facts.fact: StackAdapt announced on November 15, 2019 that its Co-Founder and COO, Vitaly Pecherskiy, was named part of CASCON x Evoke Canada's Tech Titans: Top 19 of 2019.
facts.quote: our own Co-Founder and COO, Vitaly Pecherskiy has been named as part of CASCON x Evoke Canada’s Tech Titans: Top 19 of 2019

facts.fact: CASCON x Evoke hosted its Tech Titans Awards Gala on November 5, 2019 at the Hilton Toronto/Markham Conference Centre.
facts.quote: CASCON x Evoke hosted an Awards Gala on November 5, 2019 at the Hilton Toronto/Markham Conference Centre

facts.fact: The CASCON x Evoke Awards Gala featured over 500 attendees.
StackAdapt describes itself as a self-serve programmatic advertising platform used by digital marketers.
facts.quote: StackAdapt is a self-serve programmatic advertising platform used by the most exceptional digital marketers.

facts.fact: The Canada's Tech Titans: Top 19 of 2019 final selection was completed by a judging panel of senior technology executives from some of the world's largest organizations.
facts.quote: The final selection process for Canada’s Tech Titans: Top 19 of 2019 Award Winners was completed by CASCON x Evoke’s 2019 Judging Panel consisting of senior technology executives
